SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000;
SELECT SP.SPP_IDX AS spp_idx, SP.SPP_PURCHASE AS spp_purchase, SP.SPP_NO AS spp_no, SP.SPP_NAME AS spp_name, SP.SPP_GYU AS spp_gyu, SP.SPP_YONG AS spp_yong, SP.SPP_PROPER AS spp_proper, SP.SPP_IMAGE AS spp_image, SP.SPP_BIGO AS spp_bigo, SP.FILE_NAME AS file_name,
ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_INPUT), 0) AS sph_input, ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_SURIOUT), 0) AS sph_suriout, ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_JASANOUT), 0) AS sph_jasanout, ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_INPUT), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_SURIOUT), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(SH.SPH_JASANOUT), 0) AS spp_jaigo
FROM SPAREPART SP WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN SPAREHISTORY SH WITH(NOLOCK) ON SP.SPP_IDX = SH.SPP_IDX WHERE SP.SPP_IDX = #{spp_idx} GROUP BY SP.SPP_IDX, SP.SPP_PURCHASE, SP.SPP_NO, SP.SPP_NAME, SP.SPP_GYU, SP.SPP_YONG, SP.SPP_PROPER, SP.SPP_IMAGE, SP.SPP_BIGO, SP.FILE_NAME

SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; SELECT SPAREPART.SPP_PURCHASE AS SPP_PURCHASE_HIS, SPAREPART.SPP_NO AS SPP_NO_HIS, SPAREPART.SPP_NAME AS SPP_NAME_HIS, SPAREPART.SPP_GYU AS SPP_GYU_HIS, SPAREPART.SPP_YONG AS SPP_YONG_HIS, SPAREHISTORY.SPH_IDX, -- 반드시 PK SPH_TIME, SPH_INPUT, SPH_SURIOUT, SPH_JASANOUT, SPH_BIGO, SPH_USER, SPAREHISTORY.SPP_IDX AS spp_idx_his FROM SPAREHISTORY WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SPAREPART WITH(NOLOCK) ON SPAREPART.SPP_IDX = SPAREHISTORY.SPP_IDX WHERE SPAREHISTORY.SPP_IDX = #{spp_idx} ORDER BY SPH_TIME DESC
mapper.update: SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; UPDATE [dbo].[SPAREHISTORY] SET SPH_TIME = #{sph_time} --SPH_TIME, datetime ,SPH_INPUT = #{sph_input} --SPH_INPUT, int ,SPH_SURIOUT = #{sph_suriout} --SPH_SURIOUT, int ,SPH_JASANOUT = #{sph_jasanout} --SPH_JASANOUT, int ,SPH_BIGO = #{sph_bigo} --SPH_BIGO, nvarchar(100) ,SPH_USER = #{sph_user} --SPH_USER, nvarchar(20) WHERE SPH_IDX = #{sph_idx}
